video.source: client-supplied (repo upload) — this file is the original hero clip concatenated with a second client-supplied clip ("scroll scrubbed 2.mp4") that continues the same scroll-scrub into a front-view close-up of the brain, ending where the interactive reveal panel picks up.
video.optimization: re-encoded H.264 ALL-INTRA (-g 1: every frame a keyframe), crf24, faststart, audio removed. The two clips were re-encoded to identical codec parameters and joined with an ffmpeg concat filter before this final all-intra pass, so every frame across the full merged timeline — not just each original clip — is independently seekable. All-intra makes an arbitrary seek a single-frame decode instead of decoding forward from the previous keyframe, which is what makes scroll-scrubbing feel smooth.
